entities.name: Lalla Abla Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Lalla Abla Mosque, also known as the Port Mosque, is a mosque in Tangier, Morocco, completed in 2017 and dedicated by King Mohammed VI in July 2018. It replaced a smaller mosque at a nearby location, also known as the Port Mosque.
